paragraphs.text: Agnomakhos was the leader of the Archon tyrants of Theros , who ruled for hundreds of years over Trax, a massive empire of Centaurs , Humans , leonin , Minotaurs , and Satyrs in ancient times.

Agnomakhos used the leonin as an army, and ruled a particularly brutal regime centered in modern Meletis that extended into the mountains to the north and the forests to the east, using the pretext of a war against the giants to legitimize his rule. Eventually, the empire of Trax fell to a rebellion led by kings Kynaios and Tiro , and the first polis, Meletis , was born from its ashes.
When leading his forces, Agnomakhos rode a flying bull into battle.
